results.name: Earthquake in Vanuatu
results.reason: On the 17 December 2024 at 02:00 UTC, a magnitude 7.3 Earthquake is reported to have affected the Pacific island nation of Vanuatu. The event caused widespread destruction triggering landslides, crushing cars and flattening multiple buildings. Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping is requested to provide damage assessment emergency mapping.
